mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE redirects(source_id,target_id) AS ( SELECT source_id,target_id FROM food_merge_receipt WHERE user_id=#{_userId,jdbcType=BIGINT} UNION ALL SELECT source_id,target_id FROM food_item_move_receipt WHERE user_id=#{_userId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND source_removed ), destinations(request_id, current_id) AS ( SELECT request_id, target_id FROM food_merge_receipt WHERE user_id=#{_userId,jdbcType=BIGINT} UNION SELECT d.request_id, r.target_id FROM destinations d JOIN redirects r ON r.source_id=d.current_id ), events AS ( SELECT h.history_id, h.food_id, COALESCE(h.recorded_food_name,m.food_name) AS food_name, h.action_type, h.previous_storage_type, h.new_storage_type, h.quantity_text, h.created_at, h.changes_text, m.master_id AS current_master_id, m.food_name AS current_food_name, NULL::varchar AS merged_from_name, NULL::varchar AS merged_into_name, NULL::integer AS merged_item_count, 0 AS event_order, h.history_id::text AS event_key FROM food_history h JOIN food_item f ON f.food_id = h.food_id JOIN food_master m ON m.master_id=f.master_id AND m.user_id=#{_userId,jdbcType=BIGINT} UNION ALL SELECT NULL::bigint, NULL::bigint, r.source_name, NULL::varchar, NULL::varchar, NULL::varchar, NULL::varchar, r.created_at, NULL::text, m.master_id, m.food_name, r.source_name, r.target_name, r.item_count, 1, r.request_id::text FROM food_merge_receipt r LEFT JOIN ( SELECT d.request_id, m.master_id, m.food_name FROM destinations d JOIN food_master m ON m.master_id=d.current_id ) m ON m.request_id=r.request_id WHERE r.user_id=#{_userId,jdbcType=BIGINT} UNION ALL SELECT NULL::bigint, r.food_id, r.source_name, 'MOVE'::varchar, NULL::varchar, NULL::varchar, NULL::varchar, r.created_at, '음식명: ' || r.source_name || ' (#' || r.source_id || ') → ' || r.target_name || ' (#' || r.target_id || ')' AS changes_text, m.master_id, m.food_name, NULL::varchar, NULL::varchar, NULL::integer, 2, r.request_id::text FROM food_item_move_receipt r JOIN food_item f ON f.food_id=r.food_id JOIN food_master m ON m.master_id=f.master_id AND m.user_id=#{_userId,jdbcType=BIGINT} ) SELECT history_id, food_id, food_name, action_type, previous_storage_type, new_storage_type, quantity_text, created_at, changes_text, current_master_id, current_food_name, merged_from_name, merged_into_name, merged_item_count FROM events ORDER BY created_at DESC, event_order DESC, history_id DESC NULLS LAST, event_key DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO food_history(user_id,food_id, action_type, previous_storage_type, new_storage_type, quantity_text, created_at, changes_text, recorded_food_name) VALUES (#{_userId,jdbcType=BIGINT},#{foodId}, #{actionType}, #{previousStorageType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{newStorageType}, #{quantityText,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createdAt}, #{changesText,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, (SELECT m.food_name FROM food_item i JOIN food_master m ON m.master_id=i.master_id WHERE i.user_id=#{_userId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND i.food_id=#{foodId}))
